scripts.text: You have too many items to proceed with the quest.
scripts.translation: 携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。

scripts.text: Please lighten your load and try again.
scripts.translation: 请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text: You... don't look familiar to me... ?
scripts.translation: 你...看起来有点眼生...？

scripts.text: Are you going to threaten me?
scripts.translation: 你要威胁我吗？

scripts.text: No, right?
scripts.translation: 不是吧？

scripts.text: I have my reasons.
scripts.translation: 我有自己的理由。

scripts.text: Please, pretend not to see me.
scripts.translation: 请当作没看见我。

scripts.text: From now on, I'll stay here quietly and not interrupt anyone until the siege ends.
scripts.translation: 从现在起，直到攻城战结束，我都会安静地待在这里，不打扰任何人。

scripts.text: Don't worry about me.
scripts.translation: 不用担心我。

scripts.text: I feel so grateful all the time about you letting me stay here.
scripts.translation: 你愿意让我留在这里，我一直都很感激。

scripts.text: It's nothing special... but if you want, I'll make you tools that could be of use.
scripts.translation: 虽然不是什么特别的东西...不过你需要的话，我可以帮你制作些有用的工具。

scripts.text: I mean if the guild master wants it.
scripts.translation: 我是说，如果公会会长需要的话。

scripts.text: I'm also a master who pursues the ultimate way.
scripts.translation: 我也是一位追求极致之道的大师。

scripts.text: I hope I can find that way here.
scripts.translation: 希望能在这里找到那条道路。

scripts.text: Ah... Master.
scripts.translation: 啊...大师。

scripts.text: I feel so thankful all the time.
scripts.translation: 我一直都心怀感激。

scripts.text: Since I owe you big time, I'll help you with anything anytime.
scripts.translation: 我欠你这么大的人情，无论何时你需要什么，我都会帮忙。

scripts.text: Make Hervor.
scripts.translation: 打造赫尔薇尔

scripts.text: Fuse materials.
scripts.translation: 融合材料

scripts.text: Relax.
scripts.translation: 休息

scripts.text: ^ff0000Valkyrja's Shield is needed in the process of making Hervor.
scripts.translation: ^ff0000制作赫尔沃时需要女武神之盾。

scripts.text: You should not possess any other items except for Valkyrja's Shields in order to proceed with the quest.^ff0000
scripts.translation: 继续任务时，除女武神之盾外请勿携带其他物品。^ff0000

scripts.text: ^ff0000Even if the refinement level and cards have been applied, the process requires any one of the Valkyrja's Shields you may have.
scripts.translation: ^ff0000即使女武神之盾已经精炼或插卡，制作时也只需要其中任意一面。

scripts.text: Please try again after organizing your possessions.^000000
scripts.translation: 整理好物品后请再试一次。^000000

scripts.text: Organize possessions.
scripts.translation: 整理物品

scripts.text: Continue as it is.
scripts.translation: 就这样继续

scripts.text: You've decided to keep Valkyrja's Shields only.
scripts.translation: 您决定只保留瓦尔基里亚钢盾。

scripts.text: I see that you've developed the fortress as you promised.
scripts.translation: 看来你信守承诺，把要塞发展起来了。

scripts.text: Moreover, you've found Velund's items...
scripts.translation: 而且，你还找到了维伦德的物品...

scripts.text: ... so..let's get the work done.
scripts.translation: ...那么...开始干活吧。

scripts.text: Before the girls find us...
scripts.translation: 趁那些女孩找到我们之前...

scripts.text: The girls... ?
scripts.translation: 那些女孩...？

scripts.text: ... yeah, there were some girls..
scripts.translation: ...对，是有几个女孩..

scripts.text: I had to run away because of them...
scripts.translation: 我就是因为她们才逃出来的...

scripts.text: Oh, no... !
They're here..!!
scripts.translation: 她们来了..!!

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交给我吧

scripts.text: ^4d4dff!- Instruction -!
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff!- 说明 -!

scripts.text: Soon, 7 girls that are after {0} will try to invade the fortress.
scripts.translation: 很快，盯上{0}的7名女孩就会试图入侵要塞。

scripts.text: You have to protect {0} for 1 hour.^000000
scripts.translation: 你必须保护{0}整整1小时。^000000

scripts.translation: ^4d4dff!- 说明 -!

scripts.text: When the actual attack starts, the doorway of Emperium region will be blocked up for protection.^000000
scripts.translation: 正式攻击开始后，为了保护要塞，通往Emperium区域的入口将会封锁。^000000

scripts.text: Hervor is a shield named after Hervor the Valkyrie.
scripts.translation: 赫尔沃是一面以女武神赫尔沃命名的盾牌。

scripts.text: I didn't know this fortress would have the items that used to belong to Velund, a husband of Hervor...
scripts.translation: 我没想到这座要塞里竟然有曾属于赫尔沃丈夫维伦德的物品...

scripts.text: If we use them, we could make Hervor.
scripts.translation: 用这些东西就能制作赫尔沃。

scripts.text: It's like a dream come true for me... my hands are shaking.
scripts.translation: 这简直像梦想成真...我的手都在发抖。

scripts.text: However, it seems like we need more materials.
scripts.translation: 不过，看来我们还需要更多材料。

scripts.text: Could you check again? I'll give you the list of what we need.
scripts.translation: 你能再确认一下吗？我把所需材料清单给你。

scripts.text: However, would it be okay if I said something?
scripts.translation: 不过，我能说句话吗？

scripts.text: Hervor is one of the most powerful battlegears I make and you deserve to receive something like that from me...
scripts.translation: 赫尔沃是我能制作的最强装备之一，你理应从我这里得到这样的东西...

scripts.text: but I would like you to have the minimum qualification at least.
scripts.translation: 但我希望你至少达到最低资格要求。

scripts.text: Manage this fortress well and raise ^4d4dffits commerce level by 30 or more^000000.
scripts.translation: 好好经营这座要塞，将^4d4dff商业等级提升至少30级^000000。

scripts.text: With great power comes great responsibility and duty.
scripts.translation: 力量越大，责任和义务也越大。

scripts.text: I would like you to master the basics first.
scripts.translation: 我希望你先掌握好基础。

scripts.text: I'll make you Hervor afterward.
scripts.translation: 之后我再为你制作赫尔沃。

scripts.text: Let me give you the list of materials if you want.
scripts.translation: 需要的话，我可以把材料清单给你。

scripts.text: That is so nice of you to say that.
scripts.translation: 你这么说真是太好了。

scripts.text: By the way, I wonder how my younger brother Cano is doing?
scripts.translation: 对了，不知道我弟弟卡诺现在怎么样了？

scripts.text: I'm sure he's doing fine just like I am.
scripts.translation: 我相信他也和我一样，一切都好。

scripts.text: ... I hope things stay as peaceful as they are now.
scripts.translation: ...希望这样的平静能一直持续下去。

scripts.text: Did you hear the news?
scripts.translation: 你听说了吗？

scripts.text: The girls are coming.
scripts.translation: 那些女孩来了。

scripts.text: The merciless girls!!!
scripts.translation: 那些冷酷无情的女孩！！！

scripts.text: They'll get here any minute since they've declared war already.
scripts.translation: 她们已经宣战了，随时都会打过来。

scripts.text: I'm sure they're coming to get Hervor.
scripts.translation: 她们肯定是冲着赫尔沃来的。

scripts.text: Stop them. Please!
scripts.translation: 请阻止她们！

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交给我吧

scripts.text: What do you mean 'the girls?'
scripts.translation: 你说的“那群女孩”是指？

scripts.text: Thank you...
scripts.translation: 谢谢你...

scripts.text: I'm sorry that I'm causing you troubles, but my hands are tied.
scripts.translation: 抱歉给你添麻烦了，可我也无能为力。

scripts.text: Please, stop them for me!
scripts.translation: 拜托你替我拦住她们！

scripts.text: ... They are the girls who want to be Valkyries...
scripts.translation: ...她们是想成为女武神的女孩...

scripts.text: and they always go around in groups of seven.
scripts.translation: 而且总是七个人一起行动。

scripts.text: What they want is a powerful battlegear...
scripts.translation: 她们想要的是强力装备...

scripts.text: They always threatened my younger brother Cano and me.
scripts.translation: 她们一直在威胁我和弟弟卡诺。

scripts.text: They were satisfied with basic weapons at first, but
scripts.translation: 一开始她们还满足于普通武器，

scripts.text: soon they started threatening us saying that they need something more powerful in order to become Valkyries.
scripts.translation: 后来就开始威胁我们，说要成为女武神就得有更强的装备。

scripts.text: I couldn't stand it, so I ran away... but they're here...
scripts.translation: 我实在受不了才逃走...没想到她们还是追来了...

scripts.text: You have to be careful since they found out that materials for Hervor are here.
scripts.translation: 她们已经知道赫尔沃的材料在这里了，你一定要小心。

scripts.text: Ah stop following me around!
scripts.translation: 啊，别再跟着我了！

scripts.text: If you could just get rid of them... Hervor, that's right! I'll make you Hervor!
scripts.translation: 只要你能把她们赶走...赫尔沃，对了！我会为你制作赫尔沃！

scripts.text: When will they ever stop following me...
scripts.translation: 她们到底什么时候才肯放过我...

scripts.text: Now I'm scared of girls in general... and I'm too scared to do anything...
scripts.translation: 现在我看到女孩就害怕...什么都不敢做了...

scripts.text: He's babbling now.
scripts.translation: 他又开始胡言乱语了。

scripts.text: Just wait and he'll calm down.
scripts.translation: 等一会儿，他就会冷静下来的。

scripts.text: You have to get rid of those girls first.
scripts.translation: 你得先把那些女孩解决掉。

scripts.text: ... Although I managed to escape from them again...
scripts.translation: ...虽然我又一次从她们手里逃出来了...

scripts.text: it's hard.
scripts.translation: 但这太难了。

scripts.text: life is... just so hard.
scripts.translation: 人生...真是太艰难了。

scripts.text: I'm so exhausted that I can't do anything.
scripts.translation: 我累得什么也做不了了。

scripts.text: ... I don't think I can do anything for a while, whether it's producing or smithing or whatever it is.
scripts.translation: ...我想我暂时什么也做不了，无论是制作、锻造还是其他事情。

scripts.text: I'm sorry. I'll take a break.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我要休息一下。

scripts.text: I can finally breathe now.
scripts.translation: 我总算能松口气了。

scripts.text: I'll start making Hervor as promised.
scripts.translation: 我这就按约定开始制作赫尔沃。

scripts.text: Make Hervor.
scripts.translation: 打造赫尔薇尔

scripts.text: Fuse materials.
scripts.translation: 融合材料

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 现在不行

scripts.text: You've decided to keep Valkyrja's Shields only.
scripts.translation: 您决定只保留瓦尔基里亚钢盾。

scripts.text: Oh... thank you.
scripts.translation: 哦...谢谢你。

scripts.text: I can't believe I'm finally touching these materials myself...
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信，我终于能亲手触碰这些材料了...

scripts.text: Here it is.
scripts.translation: 做好了。

scripts.text: Wasn't it fast although we had to go through many steps?
scripts.translation: 虽然步骤不少，但做得挺快吧？

scripts.text: I was so overwhelmed that it felt as short as a moment.
scripts.translation: 我太激动了，感觉一眨眼就完成了。

scripts.text: Hervor, a shield that Blacksmith Velund made for his wife Hervor, is finally made
scripts.translation: 铁匠维伦德为妻子赫尔沃打造的盾牌赫尔沃，终于在

scripts.text: at the hands of {0}.
scripts.translation: {0}手中诞生了。

scripts.text: Whew.. I don't think I can work for a while.
scripts.translation: 呼..我想我暂时没法工作了。

scripts.text: I'm all exhausted. Hahaha...
scripts.translation: 我已经筋疲力尽了。哈哈哈...

scripts.text: However, it seems like we need more materials.
scripts.translation: 不过，看来我们还需要更多材料。

scripts.text: Could you check again? I'll give you the list of what we need.
scripts.translation: 你能再确认一下吗？我把所需材料清单给你。

scripts.text: Now is actually the right time to make it.
scripts.translation: 现在正是制作它的好时机。

scripts.text: By the time next Emperium appears, there won't be any chances left.
scripts.translation: 等下一个Emperium出现时，就没有机会了。

scripts.text: Also, keep in mind the fact that I can only do this once a week.
scripts.translation: 还有，记住我每周只能制作一次。

scripts.text: I'm tired a little bit.
scripts.translation: 我有点累了。

scripts.text: I think I should rest for a few days.
scripts.translation: 我想我该休息几天。

scripts.text: I may look just fine, but I was mentally very tired.
scripts.translation: 我看起来或许没事，但精神上已经很疲惫了。

scripts.text: It's strange.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪。

scripts.text: I can't tell how I feel.
scripts.translation: 我说不上来是什么感觉。

scripts.text: Am I having some kind of a health problem?
scripts.translation: 我是不是身体出了什么问题？

scripts.text: Is it something uncurable?
scripts.translation: 这是无法治愈的吗？

scripts.text: We need as many materials as these.
scripts.translation: 我们需要这些数量的材料。

scripts.text: By the way, Muspellium and Essence of Rune need to be made separately with additional materials.
scripts.translation: 另外，穆斯贝利姆和符文精华需要用额外材料分别制作。

scripts.text: In order to make Muspellium, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons^000000.
scripts.translation: 制作穆斯贝利姆需要^4d4dff合成50个铝和50个神之金属^000000。

scripts.text: For Essence of Rune, you need to ^4d4dffcombine 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones^000000.
scripts.translation: 制作符文精华需要^4d4dff合成200块远古粗糙符文石和100块神秘粗糙符文石^000000。

scripts.text: I'll make Muspellium and Essence of Rune anytime upon your request,
scripts.translation: 只要你开口，我随时都能制作穆斯贝利姆和符文精华，

scripts.text: and of course, I'll make Jormungand as soon as we gather all the materials needed.
scripts.translation: 当然，材料一凑齐，我就会马上制作耶梦加得。

scripts.text: What I'm doing is never enough compared to what you've done for me.
scripts.translation: 和你为我做的一切相比，我做的这些根本不算什么。

scripts.text: However, you won't be able to find Velund's items.
scripts.translation: 不过，你是找不到维伦德的物品的。

scripts.text: ... but people say they definitely appear to those who truly want it. I wish you all the luck.
scripts.translation: ...不过听说，真正渴望它们的人一定能找到。祝你好运。

scripts.text: Which material do you want to make?
scripts.translation: 你想制作哪种材料？

scripts.text: Muspellium
scripts.translation: 精魔矿石

scripts.text: Essence of Rune
scripts.translation: 符文魔力精髓

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text: I'll make Muspellium with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation: 我会用你准备好的材料制作穆斯贝利姆。

scripts.text: It shouldn't take long.
scripts.translation: 用不了多久。

scripts.text: Here it is.
scripts.translation: 做好了。

scripts.text: It is an essential material for making Hervor and Jormungand.
scripts.translation: 这是制作赫尔沃和耶梦加得必不可少的材料。

scripts.text: In order to make Muspellium,
scripts.translation: 制作穆斯贝利姆需要：

scripts.text: ^4d4dffyou need 50 Eluniums and 50 Oridecons.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff50个铝和50个神之金属。^000000

scripts.text: We should have all the materials ready, right?
scripts.translation: 材料应该都准备齐了吧？

scripts.text: I'll make Essence of Rune with the materials you've prepared.
scripts.translation: 我会用你准备好的材料制作符文精华。

scripts.text: It shouldn't take long.
scripts.translation: 用不了多久。

scripts.text: Here it is.
scripts.translation: 做好了。

scripts.text: It is an essential material for making Hervor and Jormungand.
scripts.translation: 这是制作赫尔沃和耶梦加得必不可少的材料。

scripts.text: For Essence of Rune,
scripts.translation: 制作符文精华需要：

scripts.text: ^4d4dffyou need 200 Ancient Rough Runestones and 100 Mystic Rough Runestones.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff200块远古粗糙符文石和100块神秘粗糙符文石。^000000

scripts.text: Surely, it takes a lot...
scripts.translation: 确实需要不少材料...

scripts.text: Tell me whenever you need it.
scripts.translation: 需要时随时告诉我。

scripts.text: I'm glad I can at least do this for you.
scripts.translation: 至少能为你做这件事，我很高兴。

scripts.text: Also, a place where you can find materials for {0}...
scripts.translation: 而且，这个能找到{0}所需材料的地方...

scripts.text: this is like a dream place for me, too.
scripts.translation: 对我来说也像是梦境一般。
